nodes.statement: Fix smooth projective, rational cohomology, and cycle-class semantics.
Prove equivalence with rational generation by subvariety classes.
Restricted theorem lane active: HC-R021-A8-SW-Q3 is selected; construct cycles for every allowed codimension-four rational Hodge class on C_8,3.
Fix C_8,3: the generic Hodge-ring locus in the selected Q(sqrt(-3)) split-Weil abelian-eightfold component.
Construct cycles for the divisor-generated summand of every allowed alpha.
Verify the Section-12 secant objects and Fourier-Mukai object satisfy the algebraic, rank, Hodge-persistence, and nonzero-Weil-projection conditions.
If sigma_E is injective on Im(ev_E), then every first-order Hodge-preserving direction xi has vanishing obstruction ev_E(xi).
Close the all-orders deformation bridge by Question 11.4 in the required scope or by full semiregularity of the specific object.
Transport a nonzero algebraic Weil class through the entire selected component without generic-to-special quantifier drift.
Use algebraic K-endomorphism correspondences to generate every Weil class.
Combine divisor and Weil preimages to construct z for arbitrary alpha in Hdg^8(A,Q).

forbidden_shortcuts: Assume algebraicity of inverse Lefschetz correspondences or Kunneth projectors without an independent theorem.
Replace rational projective Hodge by the false integral or unrestricted compact-Kahler analogue.
Treat Hodge-locus algebraicity or first-order Hodge persistence as construction of a relative algebraic cycle.
Promote a theorem on the generic Hodge-ring locus to every special fiber.
Treat numerical, Tate, absolute-Hodge, or motivated evidence as an algebraic-cycle construction.
claim_boundary: HC-R021-A8-SW-Q3 is selected but unproved. HC-R021-L001 is a Solve-level first-order lemma only. HC-P04 and the full Hodge conjecture remain open.
